flavor.phonemic_palette: Fused Celtic-Japonic: soft, vowel-rich; lenition (c>ch, t>th) meets the open CV mora; consonants k g t d s sh ch ts n m r w y, glottal stop; endings fuse Celtic -an/-ach with Japonic -no/-ama/-shi; pitch-and-stress mixed.
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Celtic + Japanese per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Celtic + Japanese register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'shidhean'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Shidhean — wary clan confederation of the forest; honor, tradition.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Shidhean (Celtic + Japanese) are a assertive clan confederation people seeded in forest, hills, mountains. They prize honor, tradition, glory, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, archers, light_cavalry. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, nature, knowledge.
